note: The application-key rule of SPEC 3.9 applies at the top level of a document only. A key containing a full stop on any other object is an unrecognised key (SPEC 6.2): diagnose it, skip the key, keep the item. The top-level app.viatrail.datatypes in the same file is an application key and is not reported, so a reader that tests every object's keys for a full stop, and one that tests none, both fail this case. Information about one object belongs in its data array.
